items.title: Grok 4.7 is now available in GitHub Copilot - GitHub Changelog
items.summary_zh: GitHub 宣布在 Copilot 中逐步上线 xAI 的 Grok 4.7，可在 VS Code、Visual Studio、Copilot CLI、JetBrains、Xcode、Eclipse 和 Copilot cloud agent 等入口选择。企业管理员可通过 model policy 控制是否开放该模型，计费采用 provider list pricing 的 usage-based billing。
items.summary_en: GitHub announced the rollout of xAI's Grok 4.7 in Copilot, selectable across VS Code, Visual Studio, Copilot CLI, JetBrains, Xcode, Eclipse, and the Copilot cloud agent. Enterprise admins can control access via model policy, and billing follows provider list pricing under usage-based billing.
items.why_it_matters_zh: 这条更新的价值主要在于多模型治理而不是模型本身：它说明企业级 Copilot 正在把“模型选择、访问控制、成本归因”做成标准平台能力。对平台团队而言，这意味着后续内部评测、路由策略和合规审批需要按“可替换模型层”来设计。
items.why_it_matters_en: The main value here is in multi-model governance rather than the model itself: it shows enterprise Copilot turning model selection, access control, and cost attribution into standard platform capabilities. For platform teams, that implies future internal evals, routing strategy, and compliance review should be designed around a swappable model layer.
key_takeaways_zh: Grok 4.7 被纳入 GitHub Copilot 的模型选择器，覆盖 IDE、CLI 与 cloud agent 等多入口。
企业与业务版管理员可以通过 model policy 控制启用范围，提示组织级模型治理已成为一等能力。
公告没有给出编码基准、代理任务表现、延迟或成本对比，因此当前更适合作为待评测选项而非默认采用依据。
key_takeaways_en: Grok 4.7 is being added to the GitHub Copilot model picker across IDE, CLI, and cloud-agent surfaces.
Business and Enterprise admins can govern access through model policy, reinforcing model governance as a first-class organizational capability.
The announcement provides no coding benchmarks, agent-task results, latency, or cost comparisons, so it should be treated as an option to evaluate rather than a basis for default adoption.

implications_zh: 如果你负责内部 AI 编码平台，应把模型评测、访问控制、预算限制和回滚机制做成统一层，而不是绑死单一模型。
在缺乏公开技术数据的情况下，任何新模型进入开发流程前都应先跑你自己的任务集：仓库理解、PR 生成、代码评审、CLI 修复与长链路代理任务。
implications_en: If you own an internal AI coding platform, you should implement evaluation, access control, budget limits, and rollback as a common layer instead of coupling to a single model.
Without public technical evidence, any newly added model should be tested on your own task suite first: repo understanding, PR generation, code review, CLI repair, and long-horizon agent workflows.
